selectedDirection.customerQuestion: Given enabled Saving phases and contributions, what Medical Reserve Support is required and what genuine-data-supported reserve value remains each year?

phaseModel.basis: Each phase is an independent HKD 5Pay Saving block; phases are not synthetic 10Pay or 15Pay products.
phaseModel.timingEvidence: The existing AVA Saving concept labels sequential blocks as years 1–5, 6–10 and 11–15; the research portfolio code also creates independent policies at five-year issue-age offsets.

customerResultViews.definition: Phase 1 and Phase 2 calculated independently; support rotates in consecutive five-year windows from Phase 1 to Phase 2.
All three phases calculated independently; support rotates in consecutive five-year windows from Phase 1 to Phase 2 to Phase 3.

genuineDataCoverage.product: AIA 環宇盈活儲蓄保險計劃
availableEvidence: annual post-withdrawal total and component rows

contributionSupport.direct: Exact anchors 40000, 70000, 100000, 130000, 150000, 180000 and 200000 HKD per year, subject to represented issue age and Policy Year.
contributionSupport.interpolated: Between adjacent anchors, piecewise Premium-to-Basic interpolation and Basic-normalized no-withdrawal values are evidence-supported only as an explicitly INTERPOLATED path. First support may then use the validated subtraction identity. Repeated arbitrary support is not thereby validated.
unsupported: annual contributions below HKD 40000 or above HKD 200000
issue ages other than 40, 45 and 50 without a separately validated issue-age rule
Policy Years beyond the represented issue-age range
arbitrary repeated-support schedules that do not match a genuine audited path

verifiedCalculationRules.rule: component(PY, current Basic Amount) = genuine no-withdrawal component(PY) / original Basic Amount * current Basic Amount
remaining value = genuine no-withdrawal total - current Medical Reserve Support
support = RB support + associated TD support + GCV support
Basic Amount reduction = GCV support / (no-withdrawal GCV(PY) / original Basic Amount)
post-support GCV = no-withdrawal GCV(PY) / original Basic Amount * current Basic Amount

annualForwardSequence: Validate the phase configuration, contribution coverage, issue age and Policy Year coverage.
Resolve each enabled phase independently to an exact or explicitly interpolated Basic Amount and genuine no-withdrawal path.
Request a complete Official annual premium range for supportStartAge through supportEndAge, inclusive.
Before supportStartAge, apply no Medical Reserve Support.
At each support age, use that age's Official annual medical premium as required Medical Reserve Support.
Route support by five-year windows beginning at supportStartAge: activePhaseIndex = floor((attainedAge - supportStartAge) / 5) mod enabledPhaseCount.
For a first support on a phase, use the verified first-support identity.
For later support, use an exact genuine audited path only when the schedule matches; otherwise return NOT_YET_VALIDATED rather than inventing a transition.
Return age, annual premium/support, cumulative support and projected remaining value with evidence status.

phaseAggregation.formula: supportYearIndex = attainedAge - supportStartAge; windowIndex = floor(supportYearIndex / 5); activePhaseIndex = windowIndex mod enabledPhaseCount.
phaseAggregation.nonActivePhaseRule: Every enabled non-active phase continues aging on its own issue-age and Policy-Year path; routing selects only the phase funding the current support year.
